about: Model verdicts on source against tree for vat-notice-708 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The attachment title was read as a top-level chapter, so paragraph 18.2 hangs under it instead of under chapter 18 'The certificates'.
findings.evidence: source: "<h3> 18.2 Zero-rated sales and long leases" after "<h2> 18. The certificates" / tree: "Zero-rated and reduced-rated building work certificate > 18.2 Zero-rated sales and long leases"

findings.problem: The two attachment titles are kept as chapters with no number, at the same level as the numbered chapters, instead of as attachments inside 18.1 and 18.2.
findings.evidence: tree: type "chapter", title "Zero rated sales and long leases certificate", heading_path "Zero rated sales and long leases certificate"

findings.problem: The tree keeps the attachment file details that the source marks as dropped page furniture, twice.
findings.evidence: source: "[dropped: last-updated] ODT, 11.4 KB / This file is in an OpenDocument format" / tree: "ODT, 11.4 KB", "This file is in an OpenDocument format"

findings.problem: Example 2 is not under the 'Examples of calculating the taxable charge' heading, while Example 1 is, so the two examples have different parents.
findings.evidence: tree: "19.3 Buildings completed on or after 1 March 2011 > Examples of calculating the taxable charge > Example 1" / tree: "19.3 Buildings completed on or after 1 March 2011 > Example 2"

findings.problem: The example headings that follow 19.2.3 and 19.3.3 hang under 19.2 and 19.3, not under the 'Calculating the taxable charge' paragraphs they illustrate.
findings.evidence: source: "<h4> 19.2.3 Calculating the taxable charge" ... "<h4> Example" / tree: "19.2 Buildings completed before 1 March 2011 > Example"

findings.problem: The unnumbered sub-headings that follow paragraph 3.4.1 are placed under 3.4, not under 3.4.1, so their text is cut off from the paragraph they explain.
findings.evidence: source: "3.4.1 Architects, surveyors, consultants and supervisors" then "Design and build" / tree: "3.4 Services excluded from zero rating > Design and build"

findings.problem: The examples that follow a numbered sub-paragraph are placed under the parent paragraph (3.3 and 3.5), not under the sub-paragraph they illustrate.
findings.evidence: source: "3.5.2 Apportionment for mixed site developments" then "Example" / tree: "3.5 Apportionment > Example"

findings.problem: The unnumbered sub-heading that follows paragraph 5.5.1 is placed under 5.5, not under 5.5.1, so its text is cut off from the paragraph it explains.
findings.evidence: source: "5.5.1 The meaning of ‘person converting’" then "Developer" / tree: "5.5 Having ‘person converting’ status > Developer"

findings.problem: The three examples at the start are placed under 4.8, not under the sub-paragraph of 4.8 that they illustrate.
The unnumbered sub-heading that continues paragraph 5.5.1 is filed directly under 5.5, as a sibling of the numbered paragraphs, so its text loses its link to 5.5.1.
findings.evidence: source: "<h4> Contractor or subcontractor" just before "<h4> 5.5.2" / tree: "5.5 Having ‘person converting’ status > Contractor or subcontractor"

findings.problem: The two unnumbered "Example" headings that follow paragraphs 6.6.1 and 6.6.2 are filed directly under 6.6, not under the paragraph they illustrate.
findings.evidence: source: "<h4> 6.6.1 Apportionment for converting parts of buildings" then "<h4> Example" / tree: "6.6 Apportionment > Example"

findings.problem: Examples 1 to 3, which illustrate paragraph 7.3.1, are filed directly under 7.3 as siblings of 7.3.1, not under it.
findings.evidence: source: "<h4> 7.3.1 Converting and refurbishing different parts of the building at the same time" then "<h4> Example 1" / tree: "7.3 Conversions into single household dwellings > Example 1"

findings.problem: The "First rule" and "Second rule" headings, which belong to paragraph 8.3.4, are filed directly under 8.3 as siblings of 8.3.4, so their conditions lose the link to 8.3.4.
findings.evidence: source: "<h4> 8.3.4 People living in the premises whilst you carry out the work" then "<h4> First rule" / tree: "8.3 Rules for premises that have been lived in recently > Second rule"
